lessons_used: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.2% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow) and adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic and ran too high across most tests.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Backup Safety Note
candidates.change: Displays explicit reassurance text on the sign-in screen informing users that logging in saves their desktop pet safely to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.body: Sign in to safely back up your desktop pet and sync your companion across all your devices.
sign_in.hint: Your pet choices and progress will be automatically saved to your account.

guard.reason: Adds reassuring sign-in copy without violating any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence for sign-in anxiety; low cost text reassurance.

candidates.title: Path Selection Full Bleed Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen with a full-bleed layout and prominent path option cards to speed up selection.
candidates.why: The choose_path stage has a high mean duration of 514s and a 23.8% dropoff rate.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Desktop Pet Journey
choose_path.body: Select how you would like to bring your desktop pet to life today.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path layout while keeping its required function intact.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns on choose_path showed negligible historical lift (+0.1%).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on the photo upload screen advising users on lighting and pose for optimal pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 60.9% adoption conversion rate.

upload_photos.hint: Upload well-lit, clear front-facing photos to ensure your custom pet generates accurately.

guard.reason: Adds helpful guidance hint to the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step has highest dropoff (39.1%); cheap copy hint with support validation.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Mascot Audio Feedback Flow
candidates.change: Adds visual mascot animations, sound effects, and time estimates to the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and median of 201s, causing user dropoff before reaching home.

guard.reason: Enhances the waiting screen with visual feedback and a real wait time estimate.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times on home stage, but requires heavy media flow work.

candidates.title: Home Intro Compact Controls Overview
candidates.change: Switches home_intro to a compact layout detailing how to control, minimize, and talk to the desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported confusion post-onboarding regarding how to control or hide the pet.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop. Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, talk, or hide it.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro layout and controls description within onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has 35.2% dropoff and user confusion; layout tweaking is medium cost.

candidates.title: Interactive Pick Friend Preview Stage Flow
candidates.change: Upgrades the friend selection screen into a stage layout featuring live animated pet previews and sound clips.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion rate with long decision times (89s median / 1017s mean).

guard.reason: Upgrades pick_friend screen layout while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff stage, but adoption new_flow previously registered negative lift (-1.1%).

candidates.title: Sign In Connection Trouble Hint
candidates.change: Adds a diagnostic hint to the sign-in screen to assist users if the sign-in prompt stalls or fails to render.
candidates.why: Support received reports of the sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling prior to completion.

sign_in.hint: Stuck on this screen? Check your internet connection or retry signing in.

guard.reason: Adds diagnostic hint to help users stuck during sign in.

candidates.score_note: Cheap diagnostic hint directly addressing technical stall reports during sign-in.

candidates.title: Path Intro Preview Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a short dedicated introduction screen before path selection to set clear expectations about desktop pets.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path with a 514s mean time due to initial lack of context.

new_path_intro.headline: Discover Your Desktop Pet
new_path_intro.body: Prepare to adopt a virtual companion that lives and plays directly on your workspace.

guard.reason: Adds a new introductory screen before path selection without removing any required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new extra screens previously caused dropoff (-2.3% on finish new_screen).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Two Column Seal Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuilds the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout with an official seal badge replacement.
candidates.why: Adoption step overall drops to 60.9% conversion; a formal layout increases completion commitment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop companion a name to complete the adoption process.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.official_stamp[0].asset' must be a bundled onboarding asset id (asset:...)

candidates.title: Home Desktop Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Enables a ready notification trigger and hint guiding users to check their system taskbar once setup completes.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails stating the pet does not show on the desktop or the app appears unresponsive.

home_intro.hint: Look for your pet's system tray or menu bar icon if the companion doesn't appear on screen immediately.

guard.reason: Adds readiness notification and guidance hint to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Addresses post-setup invisibility issue at finish stage with modest effort.
